name: A Seoul apartment green

place_source.title: Wikidata: Seoul (Q8684), coordinate location and elevation above sea level

blurb: A small courtyard garden between Seoul apartment blocks: a paved area with potted plants, a few trees along the fence, and a shallow water feature, visited by magpies, sparrows, bulbuls and crows by day and by raccoon dogs after dark.

facts.text: Seoul has a humid continental climate (Köppen Dwa) with cold, dry winters and hot, humid summers.

facts.text: Seoul is the capital and largest city of South Korea, with a population of about 9.7 million people.

facts.text: The Oriental magpie (Pica serica) is a common and conspicuous bird in Seoul's parks and gardens, and is the national bird of South Korea.

facts.text: The raccoon dog (Nyctereutes procyonoides) is a nocturnal canid native to East Asia that adapts well to urban environments and is occasionally seen in Seoul's green spaces.
